7 Bedroom Detached Family Residence

3928 sq.ft. (364 sq.m. approx.) | BER B | Bedroom on GF | 2.35 Acre Site | 4 Bathrooms | 2 Detached Garages | 2.35 Acres | Development Potential | 

O’Mahony Walsh & Associates are delighted to present The Old Rectory, Minister’s Cross, Crookstown — a truly unique and substantial country residence extending to approximately 364 m², set amidst enchanting mature gardens and grounds.

From the moment you arrive through the striking red iron gates, framed by limestone walls and carved eagles, there is an immediate sense that this is a special property. Mature trees, colourful planting, charming bridges and secluded seating areas create a wonderful sense of privacy and tranquillity.

Inside, the home offers seven bedrooms, four bathrooms and a selection of bright, spacious reception rooms. The open-plan kitchen and dining area is ideal for family living and entertaining, while a ground-floor bedroom with shower facilities is perfect for elderly family members or multi-generational living. Oil-fired central heating and 16 solar panels contribute to an impressive B-rated BER.

Of particular interest, the property is situated within the Crookstown development boundary and, given the extent of the grounds, may offer potential for future residential sites, subject to the necessary planning permission and relevant local authority requirements.

Combining space, character, privacy, exceptional gardens and future potential, together with the convenience of a location just off the N22, The Old Rectory represents a rare opportunity to acquire a remarkable family home and a true country retreat.

Garden Details 

The gardens and grounds are a truly exceptional feature of this property, creating a private country oasis divided into three beautifully established areas.

On arrival, magnificent limestone entrance walls, crowned by two carved eagles, frame striking red iron gates and provide an impressive introduction to the property. A smaller stream meander through the grounds, complemented by charming little bridges, mature trees and further red gates that lead you through the different garden areas. Secluded benches and swing seats are thoughtfully positioned throughout, providing peaceful spots to sit, read and enjoy the wonderful surroundings.

Passing through the second set of gates, the residence comes into view, surrounded by attractive stonework and ample parking. Directly in front of the house lies another mature garden, partly laid to lawn and filled with established trees and shrubs, together with a small pond.

To the side of the house is a wonderfully sheltered sun trap, ideal for outdoor dining, while the adjoining garden is rich with mature planting and enjoys the gentle stream running alongside it.

The rear garden provides yet another private sun-filled retreat, with a patio area perfect for entertaining, a lawn bordered by mature trees and shrubs, two useful storage sheds and a charming small amphitheatre-style area offering further potential.

With flowing water, mature planting, hidden seating areas, bridges, lawns and numerous spaces for relaxing and entertaining, these enchanting grounds are undoubtedly one of the property's greatest selling points — a true garden lover's dream.
